cases.name: Valid new record
cases.input_condition: A schema-valid new exchange record with an unused ATHENA code and valid references.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Create one object; allocate internal UUID and register code only at commit; preserve provenance.

cases.name: Valid update
cases.input_condition: A valid update to an existing code with expected content version/hash.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Show field-level diff and impact; update atomically; preserve stable code and append audit event.

cases.name: Idempotent re-import
cases.input_condition: Import the exact same package twice using stable package identity and client_ref.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Second import creates no duplicate object/edge and reports idempotent no-op.

cases.name: Conflicting duplicate code
cases.input_condition: Two records in one package or registry target the same stable code with different semantic content.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Reject with both record paths; never silently choose last-write-wins.

cases.name: Dangling reference
cases.input_condition: A record points to an ATHENA code absent from active and permitted tombstone registries.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Precise JSON path and unresolved code returned; no partial writes.

cases.name: Tombstoned reference
cases.input_condition: A record references a code marked tombstoned or superseded.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Do not silently recreate or redirect; require explicit migration/alias rule.

cases.name: Schema-required field missing
cases.input_condition: A learning unit omits a required field such as objective_ids or completion_criteria.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Return schema path and requirement; no mutation.

cases.name: Invalid lifecycle enum
cases.input_condition: A record supplies an unknown status such as complete_forever.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Reject unsupported enum and provide allowed values.

cases.name: Hard prerequisite without justification
cases.input_condition: A relationship uses gating=hard but lacks a meaningful hard_gate_justification or is not PREREQUISITE_FOR/required.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Reject before graph commit; explain hard-gate invariant.

cases.name: Hard prerequisite cycle
cases.input_condition: A->B, B->C and C->A are all hard prerequisite edges.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Return the cycle path; no edges or records committed.

cases.name: Non-gating relationship cycle
cases.input_condition: A related_to B and B related_to A, or a transfer cycle, is present.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Permit valid non-prerequisite cycles; do not impose DAG constraint on the whole semantic graph.

cases.name: Duplicate client_ref
cases.input_condition: Two edge operations in one package reuse the same package-scoped client_ref with different endpoints or types.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Reject ambiguous correlation key; client_ref is not a permanent ATH-EDGE code.

cases.name: AI attempts to mint permanent ID
cases.input_condition: Incoming AI-authored payload supplies a new internal UUID or invents a permanent ATHENA code outside the approved code registry.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Application allocates internal UUID and approved stable code at commit; AI cannot mint either.

cases.name: Partial package failure
cases.input_condition: A package contains several valid records and one invalid record.
cases.acceptance_assertion: No subset is committed unless a separately approved partial-import mode exists; default is all-or-nothing.

cases.name: Evidence append-only
cases.input_condition: An update attempts to overwrite or delete an earlier evidence record.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Preserve prior evidence; corrections create a superseding/correction event with provenance.

cases.name: Export/import round trip
cases.input_condition: Export a dataset containing records, edges, aliases, tombstones, provenance and content hashes, then import into a clean test store.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Stable codes, edge semantics, tombstones and provenance remain equivalent; internal UUIDs may differ.

cases.name: Checksum or archive tampering
cases.input_condition: A package checksum does not match the bytes or the archive contains a modified manifest.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Reject before parsing/commit and preserve the prior database hash.

cases.name: Schema-version migration dry run
cases.input_condition: Import a supported older schema version with an explicit migration path.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Show deterministic migration diff, warnings and rollback point; require user approval before commit.

cases.name: Unknown relationship type
cases.input_condition: A relationship uses an unregistered relation_type.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Reject unknown relation type; never coerce to RELATED_TO.

cases.name: New code collision at commit
cases.input_condition: Two concurrent transactions attempt to register the same new stable code.
cases.acceptance_assertion: One atomic commit wins; the other re-previews or fails cleanly. Never create duplicate code mappings.

cases.name: Cross-discipline ownership mismatch
cases.input_condition: A record owner discipline conflicts with the discipline/domain relationship constraints.
cases.acceptance_assertion: Show owner and referenced discipline path; require corrected ownership or an explicit shared-scope rule.

cases.name: User rejects preview
cases.input_condition: A valid package is previewed but the user declines.
cases.acceptance_assertion: No data changes; discard staged IDs and preserve current database hash.

global_invariants: No silent stable-code minting or reassignment.
Only hard prerequisite edges must be acyclic.
Non-prerequisite semantic relationships may form cycles.
Rejected or failed transactions leave the prior database hash unchanged.
Export/import preserves semantic content, provenance, aliases and tombstones.
